title: unit template
description: A unit with {{ parameter }} places, filled from mirrorboard.toml. After filling it must be a valid unit file.

parameters.description: Every parameter this template uses; mirrorboard.toml gives each one a value.

name.description: The unit's name as people read it.

rooms.description: Rooms on the chain: registers (with a definition) and plain rooms such as agents' meta storage.

definition.description: A register's definition. Without it the room is a plain room, e.g. an agent's meta storage.

permissions.description: Who is a member of this room, and with which Actanet permissions (DATA_ROOM_PERM_*). An entry with only address reads only.

owner.description: The account that owns it: account://<key of [accounts] in mirrorboard.toml>. Without it, the organization's account owns it.

position_definition.description: The position in a definition, e.g. definition+kancelaria://spec/positions/ksiegowosc/glowny_ksiegowy.

register_definition.description: The register in a definition, e.g. definition+kancelaria://spec/registers/depozyty.

agents.description: Agents. One nested under another is created by it later; one at the top is born at the deploy.

meta.description: The room this agent keeps its memory and metadata in: room://<unit>/<room>.

permissions.description: For an agent created later (nested): members of the meta room each such agent gets. A standing agent names its meta room with meta instead.

manage_content.description: Change and delete entries, also others'.

grant_content.description: Give others access to chosen entries.

manage_permissions.description: Change members' permissions, within its own.

rotate_keys.description: Replace the room's key, e.g. after removing a member.
